decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (EX-P-000, EX-P-001, X-P-099, EX-P-100, EX-P-101, EX-P-103, EX-E-01, EX-E-02, EX-E-03, EX-S-01, EX-OB-01, EX-OB-02, PR-P-TP, Flood Risk Assessment, Design and Access Statement. Received 04/12/2018. PR-P-001, PR-P-099, PR-P-100, PR-P-101, PR-P-103, PR-E-01, PR-E-02, PR-E-03, PR-S-01, PR-S-02, PR-OB-01, EX-OB-02. Received 28/01/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the dwelling on this site and shall not be occupied as primary residential accommodation or as a separate dwelling or for business use.
description: Erection of outbuilding to rear for use as sun room and garage following demolition of existing outbuilding and erection of a rear porch following demolition of existing porch
